title.narrative: Early life saving health response to communities projected to be most affected by El Nino induced riverine flooding in Dollow district, Gedo region.

description.narrative:
ltpgtltspan style="font-size: 14px"gtThis project (in line with the Somalia Humanitarian Response Plan (HRP), the health cluster objectives, and HCT advocacy and priority focus) will seek to actualize the Emergency Preparedness and response Plan (EPRP), subset of the HRP, in ensuring early lifesaving saving health response is activated in communities that are envisaged to be most at most and affected by the El Nino induced riverine flooding in Dollow district, Gedo region.lt/spangtltbrgtlt/pgt
ltp style="" class="Default"gtThe project will seek to realize the following outcomes: lt/pgt
ltulgtltligtImproved and timely health service delivery to crisis affected communities.lt/ligtltligtCommunities have access to mental health services, case management, and referral services for survivors of sexual and gender-based violence.lt/ligtltligtImproved access to timely and quality case management and prevention of disease outbreaks at facility and community level.lt/ligtltligtImproved awareness and coping capacities of communities on response to disease outbreaks and strengthened response capacities of stakeholders.lt/ligtlt/ulgt
ltp style="" class="MsoNormal"gtltspan style="line-height: 107%"gtTo achieve this, the project will provide responsive, quality, timely and accessible health services to communities most at risk of El Nino induced in Dollow district, Gedo region by: Pre-positioning of emergency medical and non-medical supplies including SRH, CMR, cholera, and delivery kits), strengthening surveillance and RCCE initiatives, as well as IPC of Cholera/AWD through mobile and static facilities, while strengthening referral services and linkages. lt/spangtThe action will train frontline staff involved in the response on key areas like case management, Infection prevention and control (IPC), community health surveillance, Risk Communication and Community Engagement (RCCE), GBV and MHPSS thereby enhancing preventive measures through raising community awareness and promoting communities’ health through hygiene and health promotion. This will facilitate active case detection, case management, strengthening infection prevention and control (IPC) measures both at facility and community level. The Isolation centre will also be supported with essentials pharmaceuticals and other medical equipment, as well as human resources, with a view to ascertain quality in response to disease outbreaks.ltbrgtAccountability to Affected Populations remains at the heart of Trocaire's programming, and has been included in the design of this action through quarterly community dialogue sessions which will bring different stakeholders together (including women, youth, elders, community leaders, IDP camp leaders, religious leaders, service providers and local authorities), to ensure that Trocaire is being held to account, taking account, and giving account to targeted communities during the lifecycle of this action. lt/pgt
ltp style="margin-bottom: 0cm margin-top: 0cm" class="MsoNormal"gtltspan style="line-height: 107%"gtThe action will optimize existing synergies with ongoing efforts by the Health and WASH partners, and thelt/spangt Ministry of Health, in the project location, as well as build on the gains made, by Trocaire through the SHF funded Cholera Emergency lifesaving health response to flood and cholera-affected populations in Belet Xaawo, Doolow, Luuq districts of Gedo region (CBPF-SOM-23-R-INGO-25209). ltspan style="user-select: text -webkit-user-drag: none -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent text-align: justify line-height: 17.2667px" data-ccp-props="{" class="EOP SCXW67458708 BCX0"gtTo ensure an integrated response, the project will work closely withlt/spangtltspan style="text-align: justify"gt partners under Reserve Allocation 5 in Doolow including GEWDO(FSL), JF(Shelter/NFI), NAPAD(WASH), and SEDHURO(Protection)lt/spangt. This intervention will set out to reach 30,000 individuals from communities at risk to El Nino induced flooding in Dollow district.lt/pgtltp class="sceditor-nlf"gtltbrgtlt/pgt
